title: heliotropium auro-argenteum
intro: Heliotropium auro-argenteum, commonly known as Golden Heliotrope, is a flowering plant species within the family Boraginaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including providing relief from fever, rheumatism, and coughs, thanks to its health benefits of anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antispasmodic and expectorant properties, which help in easing coughs and relieving respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Heliotropium auro-argenteum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
